propositions: src/rebar/llm/config.py has 793 lines against an 800-line cap with only 7 lines of headroom, blocking further configuration additions like the REBAR_LLM_MODEL deprecation alias in ticket d23e

Lines 51-152 and 190-269 of config.py constitute inert gate read-root and session-context management code (219 LOC total) that is semantically separate from configuration knobs and has not been modified since 2026-07-09

The gate context functions must be extracted to a new module gate_context.py while being re-exported from config.py to preserve all existing monkeypatch test targets and avoid breaking 13 existing test patches that target rebar.llm.config

The assert_gated function hardcodes logging.getLogger('rebar.llm.config') and this logger identity must be re-pointed to the new module post-move with a test asserting the REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED override warning is emitted under the correct logger

Moving the inert mass reduces config.py to ~631 LOC and creates ~162 lines of headroom but does not remove the 10-13 line per-knob absorber cost in from_env, providing room for ~15 additional knobs before a structural fix via spec-table declaration is needed
